The business

Hook, Line & Stitch is a small crochet business I run on Instagram. Every piece is designed and made by hand, by me.

The overlap

Crochet is where my design brain goes to play. A pattern is a system, a dropped stitch means unravelling a few rows and trying again, and every piece starts with the question I ask on every project: who is this for?
